fields.Name: T122 - AI Analytics Section Switching
fields.Description: Exercises the analytics resource's left-nav + @switch(ActiveSection) that mounts distinct child components per section - a section-router pattern not covered by the generic 'analytics renders' test.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the Analytics section. The Analytics screen has a left navigation rail listing sections (Executive Summary, Prompt Runs, Agent Runs, Model Performance, Cost & Budget, Error Analysis, Usage Patterns). Click through at least two different sections - for example switch from Executive Summary to Cost & Budget, then to Model Performance. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Success is that the content area swaps to a different analytics view for each section you select while the outer chrome stays put.

judgeValidationCriteria: A left navigation rail with multiple analytics section labels is visible
Selecting a different section (e.g. Cost & Budget, Model Performance) swaps the main content area to that section's view without a full page reload
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
